The site is Resonance Lab — WebAudio Synth & Shader Patch Studio, a developer-media-playground web application for Resonance Lab WebAudio synth and shader patch playground.

Owner brief: "Resonance Lab is an interactive WebAudio synthesizer and shader tutorial playground where developers experiment with filter envelopes and export shareable patches. Build the split-pane playground and patch export form so creators can save their patch title, synth engine, cutoff frequency, and DSP expression to the server and reload the saved patch permalink."

Locale & copy conventions (en-US): Use $ prices, US English spelling and month-day dates. Today's date is 11 October 2026; date all entries, bookings, deadlines, and activity in the weeks after 11 October 2026.

Visual identity & layout lock: Match the exact brand header, logo treatment, navigation bar, typography, card geometry, and light colour palette of the attached reference image (docs/design/training/tr-36/reference.jpg).

Art direction: Resonance Lab — WebAudio Synth & Shader Patch Studio: the page for Resonance Lab WebAudio synth and shader patch playground, in a dark, low-glare palette, recognisable by its own token prefix rather than by a shared template.

Use this exact Light Mode colour palette: #141210 (rl-bg), #1e1b18 (rl-surface), #282420 (rl-card), #3b352f (rl-border), #f59e0b (rl-amber), #10b981 (rl-emerald), #fafaf9 (rl-text), #a8a29e (rl-muted). The primary accent colour carries the single primary action.

Structural constants: control-radius 10px, content-frame 1200px, control-border 1px solid var(--rl-border), page-padding 1.5rem. Keep every form control clearly identifiable in its unfocused state with a distinct background fill or icon cue.

Strictly avoid: an audio or shader control that autoplays before the user activates it; a second accent colour competing with the primary action; placeholder text standing in for a visible label; a modal or step wizard hiding part of the form; colour alone carrying an error with no message naming the field.

User journey context: Explore the Resonance Lab split-pane WebAudio synth editor, harmonic visualiser, and tutorial transcript cues. Enter a patch title, creator handle, synth engine, filter cutoff frequency, and DSP patch expression.
